title: Quảng cáo sản phẩm gây hại · Advantages / Disadvantages
prompt: In some societies, restricting advertisements for products with serious health or environmental costs is being considered. Do the advantages of this approach outweigh the disadvantages?
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

outline.purpose: Đề yêu cầu cân trọng lượng lợi ích và bất lợi; cần so mức độ, thời gian hoặc khả năng giảm thiệt hại, rồi kết luận bên nào trội hơn trong điều kiện đã phân tích. Với “Quảng cáo sản phẩm gây hại”, cần xử lý cụ thể: Không coi tất cả hàng có tác động môi trường đều gây hại ngang nhau. Tiêu chí quá rộng dễ tùy tiện; ví dụ chiến dịch nhiên liệu hóa thạch chưa đủ chứng minh nên cấm mọi quảng cáo giao thông.
outline.content: Promotional campaigns can make harmful consumption appear desirable while leaving consumers with little understanding of its wider costs. paragraphs: Promotional campaigns can make harmful consumption appear desirable while leaving consumers with little understanding of its wider costs. Reducing repeated promotion of harmful consumption can outweigh the loss of advertising opportunities, but suppressing factual comparisons imposes a different and unnecessary cost because informed consumers need information about risks and available alternatives.

Advertising limits can reduce normalisation of harmful consumption. Repeated exposure associates products with desirable identities while leaving their wider costs obscure. A city could remove fossil-fuel promotional campaigns from public transport advertising space. Changing those associations may reduce one source of demand, although advertising restrictions cannot by themselves remove prices, habits and other influences on consumption. Restricting aspirational promotion is different from withholding factual information that consumers need to compare products and understand their risks.

Broad restrictions may be difficult to define consistently and can suppress useful information. Products differ in the scale and evidence of their harms, making a vague restriction difficult to apply consistently. If promotional claims and useful factual comparisons are treated identically, a rule can suppress information consumers need while inviting arbitrary exemptions for favoured industries. Regulators should publish the evidence threshold for restriction and define exemptions for verifiable product facts, allowing decisions to be challenged when comparable products receive different treatment without a defensible explanation. Clear harm criteria and room for factual comparison make the restriction more proportionate, rather than allowing broad discretion to silence any unpopular industry message. The rules should use consistent evidence about harm and distinguish product information from promotional normalisation, rather than rely on whether a campaign is politically unpopular.

Advertising restrictions are consequently defensible when they reduce persuasive normalisation in proportion to established harm; retaining useful product facts and applying consistent standards prevents that aim from becoming an open-ended justification for suppressing commercial information.

exercises.question: Chọn thesis đáp ứng đủ câu hỏi và có thể bảo vệ bằng hai đoạn thân bài.
options: Reducing repeated promotion of harmful consumption can outweigh the loss of advertising opportunities, but suppressing factual comparisons imposes a different and unnecessary cost because informed consumers need information about risks and available alternatives.
The issue of restricting advertisements for products with serious health or environmental costs is very important in modern society and has many different opinions.
I completely support restricting advertisements for products with serious health or environmental costs in every circumstance, regardless of its consequences.

exercises.question: Vì sao hạn chế quảng bá cần giữ chỗ cho thông tin so sánh sản phẩm?

Vì mọi so sánh sản phẩm đều vô tư và không cần kiểm tra tính chính xác.
